verdict.rationale: Cubic's evidence covers its own AI review, custom agents, and its MCP server for connecting coding agents *to* cubic, plus support for using existing ChatGPT/Claude subscriptions — but nothing describes an ecosystem or marketplace for integrating third-party, partner-built agent apps into a lead's workflow. Missing for 10: any documented partner app directory/marketplace, integration APIs for third-party agent vendors, or case studies of external partner agents being plugged into cubic-managed workflows.
